universal_lens: Statistical learning, game theory, and computer vision form a triadic framework for AI in football analytics, enabling predictive modeling, strategic decision analysis, and automated video interpretation. Interactive decision-making integrates game theory and statistical learning to model agent behavior in multi-agent environments, enabling tactical optimization through counterfactual analysis.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference integrates player attribute vectors and action probabilities to estimate possession value and off-ball scoring opportunities via conformal prediction intervals. Bayesian inference maps strategic player behaviors to probabilistic models of decision-making, supporting conformal prediction of team and individual performance under uncertainty.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning maps player states through state-transition graphs informed by pitch control and expected possession value, enabling real-time tactical adaptation. Situational reasoning encodes state transitions via dynamic game-theoretic models, enabling real-time tactical adaptation and counterfactual scenario simulation within football match contexts.
